LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_StarryNight.nodes.0.d: Retains original mitigation: +0.7 damage-taken divisor, with other damage than bullets, cuts, stabs and blunt further divided by 3. New nodes count actual injury from ordinary hostile external hits of those other types; fully absorbed, friendly and secondary hits do not count. Progression stays with the item.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_StarryNight.nodes.1.d: Take two actual special-type hits from the same enemy, at most 4 seconds apart, to gain 50 base shield points for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Changing attackers restarts the count. Ordinary physical and fully absorbed hits do not count. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_StarryNight.nodes.2.d: An actual hostile special-type hit marks its attacker for 4 seconds, with one mark maximum, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit on that enemy consumes the mark for 50 bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_StarryNight.nodes.3.d: Under Gathering Night’s same-attacker condition, heal 20 base points of recoverable injuries on the most injured other colonist within 4 cells and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Counts independently. Never heals you instead. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_StarryNight.nodes.4.d: Under Gathering Night’s same-attacker condition, independently store one reprisal for 5 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Store at most one. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_StarryNight.nodes.5.d: After Starveil Reprisal actually deals bonus damage, deal 25 damage to one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_REF_StarryNight.nodes.6.d: After Starveil Reprisal actually deals bonus damage, shield the nearest other colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Never shields you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.
